headline: RBI releases 2026 D-SIB list: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank retain buckets
summary_points: RBI continues to identify SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank as D-SIBs, with the same bucketing structure as the 2025 list.
The additional CET1 requirement is over and above the capital conservation buffer.
The update is based on data collected from banks as on March 31, 2026.
who_is_affected: SBI, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank, along with foreign banks in India that are G-SIBs, which must maintain a proportionate CET1 surcharge.
action_required: The designated D-SIBs should ensure their additional CET1 holdings match their bucket requirement; others should note the unchanged list for analysis and disclosures.

social.linkedin:
RBI has released its 2026 list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs).

State Bank of India, HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank continue to be identified as D-SIBs, with the same bucketing structure as in the 2025 list.

Additional CET1 requirement (as % of RWAs):
- Bucket 4: State Bank of India - 0.80%
- Bucket 2: HDFC Bank - 0.40%
- Bucket 1: ICICI Bank - 0.20%
- Buckets 5 and 3 remain vacant (1% and 0.60% respectively)

This requirement is in addition to the capital conservation buffer. The assessment is based on data as on March 31, 2026, under the D-SIB framework issued on July 22, 2014 and updated on December 28, 2023.

Foreign banks in India that are G-SIBs must maintain an additional CET1 surcharge proportionate to their India RWAs.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1547).
